title: Chats

empty.title: Start a chat
empty.body: Pick a model and ask anything. You can keep typing while it works.

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Message. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

pending.note: They reach the model together, in order, at its next step.
pending.afterStop: You stopped the turn. These messages are waiting for you.
pending.afterFailure: The turn ended early. These messages are waiting for you.

tool.undoStale: Not undone. The data changed after this change, so undoing it would overwrite later work. {{detail}}
tool.undoNotFound: Not undone. The record of this change is gone.
tool.undoExpired: Not undone. This change is too old to undo.
tool.undoDenied: Not undone. Your role on this data does not allow it.
tool.undoUnknown: Not sure the undo went through. Press Undo to check; it will not run twice.
tool.undoUnavailable: Not undone. The add-on could not be reached.
tool.waiting: {{addon}} left this change waiting; it was not applied.

refused.not_permitted: You do not have the permission {{addon}} needs for this. Nothing was changed. An administrator can grant it.
refused.resource_unreachable: {{addon}} could not find that resource, or you have no access to it. Nothing was changed.
refused.not_running: {{addon}} is starting or stopped, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.

app.title: Interactive view of {{tool}}
app.unavailable: The view could not be loaded ({{reason}}). Here is the result as text.
app.notRead: the result could not be read now; the page is tried again when the turn ends

notes.compacted: The conversation was compacted to make room ({{before}} to {{after}} tokens).

errors.send: The message could not be sent.
errors.delete: The chat could not be deleted.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.chat: The chat and its messages are deleted for good.
confirmDelete.agent: Chats that use this agent are kept. Triggers that use it stop working.
confirmDelete.trigger: The trigger stops and its history of runs is deleted.
confirmDelete.skill: The skill is deleted for good.
confirmDelete.mcp: The connector is deleted with its saved token, headers and environment. A saved agent that names it can no longer use it.
confirmDelete.task: The task is deleted. Its jobs stay until their retention passes.
confirmDelete.connector: The connector stops and its settings are deleted.

memoryNotice: Chats are kept in memory only. They are lost when the server restarts.

attach.busy: Files go with a message that starts a turn. Wait for this one to end or stop it.
attach.off: Files are off on this server.
attach.queued: A file sent now waits with its message until the model takes it at its next step.

skillsPage.title: Skills
skillsPage.intro: A skill tells the model how to do one kind of task. Chats list the skills they can use, and the model reads one when a task matches. When two skills have the same name, the nearest one wins.
skillsPage.name: Name

agentsPage.title: Agents
agentsPage.intro: An agent is a saved set of instructions and tools. A chat with an agent gets only what its lists name, and only what you may use at that moment.
agentsPage.name: Name
agentsPage.grants: What a chat with this agent may use. An empty list gives nothing.
agentsPage.mcpHint: Server name from the model's MCP configuration
agentsPage.fixModel: Always use one model (otherwise you choose the model for each chat)
agentsPage.noConnectors: You have no MCP connectors yet.

triggersPage.title: Triggers
triggersPage.intro: A trigger starts a chat as you, by itself: at a time, or when a file arrives in a folder. Each run is an ordinary chat that you can open and undo.
triggersPage.name: Name
triggersPage.noAgentNote: With no agent, a run uses the model and switches of the chat that made it, and no tool that acts at once. Choose an agent to give it more.
triggersPage.proposalsNote: A proposal does nothing until you confirm it.

inbox.pushDenied: Browser notifications are blocked for this site.
inbox.pushUnavailable: This server cannot keep push subscriptions.
inbox.confirmAll_one: Remove {{count}} notification? This cannot be undone.
inbox.confirmAll_other: Remove all {{count}} notifications? This cannot be undone.
inbox.confirmRead_one: Remove {{count}} read notification? Unread ones stay.
inbox.confirmRead_other: Remove {{count}} read notifications? Unread ones stay.

connectorsPage.title: Connectors
connectorsPage.intro: A connector links a messaging platform to your chats, so people can talk to one of your agents from there. Each platform comes from a connector add-on.
connectorsPage.noAddonHint: A connector add-on carries the messages of a platform such as Telegram. Install one from the add-on gallery to add a binding.
connectorsPage.waitingText: These bindings are kept, but they do not run until their add-on is installed and turned on.

conversionPage.title: Converted from the old chat
conversionPage.intro: The old chat, agents, tasks, skills and Telegram connectors were converted when this server started. Triggers and connectors are switched off until you turn them on. A chat keeps what was said, not what the model remembered.
conversionPage.notRun: No conversion has run on this server.

tools.fallbackBuiltin: {{addon}} replaces {{tool}} but cannot serve this chat now (stopped, switched off here or not granted): the built-in {{tool}} serves.
tools.fallbackNone: {{addon}} replaces {{tool}} but cannot serve this chat now, and the built-in {{tool}} is off: this chat has no {{tool}}.

sandbox.host: Commands run directly on this machine, with no isolation
sandbox.cannot: Sandbox unavailable: this host cannot run commands
sandbox.starting: The Sandbox is starting. LocalAI checks again in {{seconds}} s.

commands.title: Commands can't run here
commands.none: No add-on that runs code is installed, so the assistant can write files but cannot run scripts or commands.
commands.off: The Sandbox add-on is off for this chat. Switch it on in the Tools menu to let the assistant run code.
commands.unavailable: The Sandbox add-on is installed but cannot run commands on this server.
commands.unavailableWhy: The Sandbox add-on cannot run commands on this server: {{reason}}
commands.askInstall: Ask an administrator to install the Sandbox add-on.
commands.askFix: Ask an administrator to fix it.
commands.chipTitle: This chat cannot run code or commands. Select for details.
commands.host: Commands run on this machine, with its files and network, not isolated. Install the Sandbox for isolation.
commands.hostOff: The Sandbox is off for this chat, so commands run on this machine, with its files and network, not isolated. Switch the Sandbox on in this menu to isolate them.
commands.hostUnavailable: The Sandbox cannot run here, so commands run on this machine, with its files and network, not isolated.
commands.hostUnavailableWhy: The Sandbox cannot run here ({{reason}}), so commands run on this machine, with its files and network, not isolated.
commands.hostChipTitle: Commands in this chat run on this machine, not isolated. Select for details.

consent.title: Run this command on this machine?
consent.body: Commands run on this machine with no isolation. They can read files that LocalAI can read and reach the internet and your network. Install the Sandbox for isolation.
consent.alwaysHint: Always on this instance lets every user's chats run commands here without asking (Settings > Tools).
consent.askAdmin: Only an administrator can allow commands on this machine. Ask one, or run the command yourself.
consent.expired: Not answered: the turn that asked has ended, so the command did not run.

mcpPage.title: MCP connectors
mcpPage.supporting: Connect MCP servers to give your chats and agents more tools, such as search or your own APIs.
mcpPage.family: Bots for Telegram or Slack are <go>messaging connectors</go>.
mcpPage.forbidden: MCP is not available to your account.

empty.fact1: Any MCP server over http or https
empty.fact3: Test it before chats use it

row.noTools: Connected, but the server offers no tools.

details.useHelp: Chats without an agent use every connector that is on. A saved agent uses only the ones you pick for it.
details.never: Not tested in this browser yet.

details.toolsUnknown: Test the connection to see the tools.

details.encrypted: Stored encrypted on the server. Never shown again.

sheet.testDesc: LocalAI connects with what you saved and lists the tools.

sheet.localHelp: A program that LocalAI starts on this machine. Administrators only.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.nameHelp: Shown in the Tools menu of a chat.
sheet.urlHelp: Servers on a private network are refused unless an administrator allows them.
sheet.commandHelp: The program to start, without a shell.

sheet.envIntro: Variables the command gets, for example an API key.
sheet.tokenSaved: A token is saved. Type a new one to replace it.

sheet.envSaved: Variables are saved. New rows replace all of them.

sheet.failHint: Check the address, then test again.

sheet.discardBody: What you typed in this form is lost.

errors.urlScheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: The connector is deleted with its saved token, headers and variables. A saved agent that uses it can no longer call its tools.

import.title: Servers kept in this browser
import.text: The old chat page kept these MCP servers in this browser. Import them to keep them on the server, where every browser and session can use them. They are made switched off. Their tokens and headers go to the server and are then removed from this browser.
import.done: Imported {{count}}. They are switched off: test and turn them on below.
import.left: The servers that were not imported stay in this browser.
